In charge of teaching a discussion section and lab to around 40 introductory CS students.
Help develop and edit curriculum and teaching materials.
Contribute to course software development.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern (Special Projects Group)
positions.description: Working with big data to help build the next big thing.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Wrote a full-stack internal web application for the Hardware PM team.
Created a python backend to query internal databases which used graph traversal algorithms to intelligently fill in missing data.
Created a front-end dashboard for the entire CPU team to use daily which utilized Javascript/PHP to create interactive tables and visualize the data.

positions.title: Co Founder
positions.description:
Co-founder and co-lead of engineering team that designed, architected, and developed our software system from the ground up.
Winner of UC Berkeley Challenge Lab Startup Competition
Winner of 2015 University Mobile Challenge, a worldwide competition with over 130 of the best college startups competing. 
Responsible for creating a full-stack javascript web portal that allows real-time visualizations of driver locations, messaging, and insightful analytics for dispatchers.
A demo of the software we built its below.

positions.title: Systems Engineering Intern - Software
positions.description:
Worked closely with internal Broadcom user groups to define, architect, execute and deploy a comprehensive 4,000 line program in C that controlled hardware components through linux drivers for an internal EJTAG probe test device. Program included control feeedback loops, SPI and I2C I/O, and FPGA sequencer timing scripts.
Developed python scripts to parse through large printed circuit board database files to extract and match board components and output them to a friendly excel document

honors.title: University Mobile Champion in Innovation
honors.description: The startup I co-founded, TouchFreight, was awarded the highest collegiate prize in an international startup competition at the 2015 Mobile World Congress competing against over 200 of the top startup teams from around the world.
honors.issuer: Issued by Applied Innovation Institute · Feb 2015

honors.title: UC Regents Scholar
honors.description: Awarded to the top 2% of applicants, the Regents Scholarship is the most prestigious merit-based scholarship at UC Berkeley.

projects.title: Secure File Storage System
projects.description: Built an end-to-end encrypted secure file storage system in python that could perform peer-to-peer sharing and revoking, gets and puts, as well as efficient updates through a log based file update system (similar to git) that was secure to outside attackers as well as a malicious server through the use of authenticated encryption including both symmetric and asymmetric schemes.

projects.title: Approximation Algorithm for an Intractable Problem
projects.description: Built an ensemble algorithm using both greedy and genetic algorithms to try to best approximate the intractable Maximum Acyclic Subgraph problem. Our algorithm placed in the top 10% of the class in the competition.

organizations.name: Accenture
organizations.position: Future Leader in Technology · Apr 2014 - Present
organizations.description: Selected from hundreds of applicants to be a part of Accentures pilot Future Leaders in Technology, a networking and mentorship program with bay area professionals. Paired with an Accenture mentor to learn from and explore the technology and consulting industry.

organizations.name: Center for Entrepreneurship and Technology Student Association
organizations.description:
Board member of the student association representing the Berkeley Center for Entrepreneurship and technology.
    CETSA connects ambitious students with the resources they need to form teams and launch their own companies. What makes us unique from other student entrepreneurship groups is that we’ve actually started businesses, and we continue to refine our projects and build new companies
    We also partner with local technology companies and startups to help qualified students find internships and employment opportunities. Though we are a multidisciplinary group composed of undergraduate and graduate students, we all share one thing in common: the ambition to succeed and the willingness to learn.
